scenarios.name: first-entry
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: A805 runs its SELECT FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1 (SQLCODE 0, MSGERRO untouched); LOW-VALUES into EPMENUO, SEND MAP EPMENU ERASE CURSOR; PROCESS-INDICATOR '3'; RETURN TRANSID('EPSP') with the 106-byte COMMAREA

scenarios.name: clear
scenarios.why: CLEAR: the map is cleared and sent again with ERASE; the COMMAREA goes back as received

scenarios.name: pf3-at-menu
scenarios.why: PF3 with PROCESS-INDICATOR '3': SEND TEXT 'END OF TRANSACTION - THANK YOU' ERASE FREEKB, then a plain RETURN (no TRANSID)

scenarios.name: pf12-at-menu
scenarios.why: PF12 is the same WHEN as PF3 (DFHPF3 OR DFHPF12)

scenarios.name: pf3-from-list
scenarios.why: PF3 with PROCESS-INDICATOR '9' (back from the company list): SEND TEXT of one blank ERASE FREEKB, SEND MAP FROM(EPMENUO) with no ERASE/DATAONLY (SEND-ALL), indicator back to '3', RETURN TRANSID

scenarios.name: other-key-from-list
scenarios.why: WHEN OTHER with indicator '9': nothing to calculate; RETURN TRANSID('EPSP') with the COMMAREA unchanged

notes: IBM DBB MortgageApplication's mortgage screen (transaction EPSP, map EPMENU of mapset EPSMORT, whose symbolic map the repository does not ship: generated from epsmort.bms, `@bms/`). Every task first runs A805's dummy SELECT IBMREQD FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1 (Db2's own one-row table: no DDL, no seed). The COMMAREA is DFHCOMMAREA (COPY EPSMTCOM: PROCESS-INDICATOR, the EPSMTINP inputs, the EPSMTOUT outputs), 106 bytes. Not reachable here: ENTER with indicator '3' (A100: RECEIVE MAP, three CALLs of EPSNBRVL, then A600's LINK to EPSCSMRT) and WHEN OTHER with '3' (A600) need EPSCSMRT, which compiles with CBL NUMPROC(MIG) -- refused (oracle_assumptions.md C5); PF9 and ENTER from the list LINK EPSMLIST, whose ESDS browse by RBA the CICS model does not implement (refused by name).
